Overview

Naha is a city in Okinawa with a population of 320,000. The tropical capital of Okinawa with unique Ryukyu culture, stunning beaches, and a year-round subtropical climate. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
